tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search Polish public procurement notices from BZP (national) and TED (EU): open calls with deadlines or awarded contracts. Filter by industry (it, construction, medicine, or a 2-digit CPV division such as 72), region, buyer city, kind and value. Returns title, buyer, CPV codes, publication date, dea

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get the registry profile of one Polish company: name, legal form, address, industry (PKD), share capital, representation rules, recent registry changes, VAT status and headline financials for the latest filed period. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP). For earlier y

tools.name: get_company_public_aid
tools.description: Get SUDOP public aid / grants for a company — full case list with amounts, grantor, measure, purpose. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.name: get_company_eu_funds
tools.description: Get European Funds (Fundusze Europejskie) projects for a company — official MFiPR lists, EU co-financing, programme and dates. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP. Cohesion/shared-management funds; not TED procurement, not FTS Commission grants, and not SUDOP state aid.

tools.name: get_company_eu_grants
tools.description: Get European Commission grants awarded directly to a Polish company (Horizon Europe, LIFE, Erasmus+ and other EU programmes from the EU Financial Transparency System). Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

tools.name: get_company_public_tenders
tools.description: Get BZP public procurement data — full awards as contractor and notices as buyer, with award values. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.name: get_company_eu_tenders
tools.description: Get TED EU-threshold public procurement — full awards as contractor and notices as buyer. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get current billing period usage and remaining quota — mcp_queries, api_requests, export_companies, ask_ai_credits, watchlist_companies. Includes limits and reset date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "tenders" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies · Public sink: search_companies, get_company · Destructive: get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies · Public sink: search_companies, get_company · Destructive: get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
